work.author: Synod of Bishops, Special Assembly for the Pan-Amazon Region
work.description: The final document of the Special Assembly of the Synod of Bishops for the Pan-Amazon Region, approved 26 October 2019 and presented to Pope Francis. A consultative synodal act, not an act of the papal magisterium. Number 111 proposes that the competent authority establish criteria for ordaining suitable and recognized men of the community who have a fruitful permanent diaconate and may have a legitimately constituted and stable family.
work.title: Documento final: Amazonia, nuevos caminos para la Iglesia y para una ecologia integral
